question: Which Linux companion app architecture should OpenClaw accept for this umbrella: the GTK/C track, the Rust/GTK4 track, a narrower split of one track, or no in-repo Linux app yet?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug: it chooses a first-class desktop app architecture, dependency model, credential boundary, packaging path, and long-term ownership surface.

options.title: Choose and narrow one Linux track
options.body: Pick the preferred GTK implementation, require a smaller security-reviewable landing slice, and close or redirect the competing app PRs.

options.title: Keep both tracks open temporarily
options.body: Allow both native Linux PRs to continue until maintainers compare security, packaging, and maintainability evidence, accepting additional review cost.

options.title: Defer in-repo Linux app
options.body: Leave Linux on the Gateway/CLI/docs path for now and route companion experiments outside core until a maintainer sponsors one.

recommendation.title: Choose and narrow one Linux track
recommendation.body: Pick the preferred GTK implementation, require a smaller security-reviewable landing slice, and close or redirect the competing app PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the umbrella and has the clearest issue-thread product-direction signal for GTK-native Linux app expectations.
